name: pdfcn
notes: MIT. Prerequisite: a React project running the Takumi (takumi-pdf + @takumi-rs/helpers) or Forme PDF renderer.

Registry index has 101 items (48 ui, 40 blocks, 9 themes, 4 lib). Every component/block ships for both renderers under takumi/ and forme/ — cataloged once per component (Takumi install; Forme variant named in the description). Theme token presets and lib items are not cataloged.
